messages.author: 9e17baabb9ce7177
messages.subject: multilevel SEM
parts:
Hello: I would very much appreciate your help with this 

I am trying to run multilevel SEM. and I have two problems. 

1. Below is the syntax I used (The syntax is from http://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/zurich2017/MULTILEVEL/lavaan_multilevel_zurich2017.pdf). But I kept saying there's an error (Error in lavParseModelString(model) : unknown operator in level=1).


digital.model <- '
level = 1
BehaveIntent =~ qd13_1 + qd13_2 + qd13_3 + qd13_4 + qd13_5
Attitud =~ Attitude
FRisk =~ FearRisk1 + FearRisk2
Useful =~ Useful1 + Useful2
Ease =~ PE
InternetUse =~ InternetUse1 + InternetUse2 + InternetUse3 + InternetUse4 + SocMedUse
Manage =~ Manager
Unemploy =~ unemployed
Studen =~ student
Manualworker =~ Manual_Worker
Age =~ d11
Aware =~ Robote_use_artificial
SocClas =~ d63 

level = 2
UnempRat =~ UnempRate
Inno =~ Innovation

#regression
BehaveIntent ~ Attitud + FRisk + Useful + Ease + Manage + Unemploy + Studen + Manualworker + Aware + UnempRat + Inno
Attitud ~ FRisk + Useful + Ease + Manage + Unemploy + Studen + Manualworker + Age + Aware + UnempRat + Inno
FRisk ~ Manage + Unemploy + Studen + Manualworker + Aware + SocClas + UnempRat + Inno
Useful ~ Manage + Unemploy + Studen + Manualworker + Aware + SocClas + UnempRat + Inno
Ease ~ Manage + Unemploy + Studen + Manualworker + Aware + SocClas + UnempRat + Inno
Aware ~ InternetUse + Age + SocClas
'
fit <- sem(digital.model, data = TechAccept, cluster = "UnempRat")
summary(fit)

2. At the level two I do want to use another variable call "Inno" but when I added it into this syntax: (fit <- sem(digital.model, data = TechAccept, cluster = "UnempRat", cluster = "Inno"). I got this message about the error: Error in sem(digital.model, data = TechAccept, cluster = "UnempRat", cluster = "Inno") : formal argument "cluster" matched by multiple actual arguments

Please explain what I did wrong. Also, is there anyway to test CFA for the multilevel SEM?

Thank you!!!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: multilevel SEM
parts: Error in lavParseModelString(model) : unknown operator in level=1

2. At the level two I do want to use another variable call "Inno" but when I added it into this syntax: (fit <- sem(digital.model, data = TechAccept, cluster = "UnempRat", cluster = "Inno"). I got this message about the error: Error in sem(digital.model, data = TechAccept, cluster = "UnempRat", cluster = "Inno") : formal argument "cluster" matched by multiple actual arguments

Please explain what I did wrong. Also, is there anyway to test CFA for the multilevel SEM?

As the error message states, you have supplied 2 different names for the clustering variable.  lavaan can only fit 2-level models, so you cannot have a second clustering variable.
